algorithm.complete_reporting: Emit all frozen masks/roles/metrics/variants/arms/endpoints/contrasts and all influence cases irrespective of direction; list failed or undefined diagnostics explicitly. For every primary-secondary comparison, explicitly state whether paired mean sign or descriptive 95 percent interval coverage of zero differs, including undefined values and differing complete-pair counts. No result changes primary inference or launch eligibility.

d8_confusion_table.normalization: Existing fixed labels and existing prediction normalization only; a trick-only prediction is other.
d8_confusion_table.use: Descriptive frequency table only; no either-gold success metric, gold union, aliases or pooled score.

equal_block_score.canonical_root_binding: Final scored transfer mapping proves only canonical duplicate roots are scored. Canonical and paraphrase variants share root provenance. Any separately scored duplicate members reject the final binding.
equal_block_score.formula: cluster=mean original retained scores within each opaque duplicate cluster or acquisition target forms; g=mean surviving cluster means within source group; b=mean surviving g within frozen block; e=mean surviving b within event; role_score=mean nonempty e within assigned role
equal_block_score.scope: every frozen replicate, all five arms and every existing acquisition/baseline/intermediate/delayed endpoint where predictions already exist; no new GPU evaluation
equal_block_score.variants: canonical and paraphrase separately; in-sample QA separately
equal_block_score.weight_basis: membership only, never correctness, loss, probe count or arm result

exposure_spacing_covariates.block: union presentations whose provenance intersects any source unit in block, count each presentation and its tokens once; compute same clock/gap summaries
exposure_spacing_covariates.clocks: use actual executed scheduled presentations and global optimizer-step, cumulative input-token and answer-target-token clocks, separately by acquisition/review/interference/buffer phase and arm
exposure_spacing_covariates.missing_provenance_or_history: diagnostic incomplete; cannot claim this reviewer condition satisfied
exposure_spacing_covariates.overlap_disclosure: one shared declaration presentation may credit several raw units; unit counts/tokens are attributed exposure, not disjoint totals; block unions avoid repeated counting inside a block
exposure_spacing_covariates.source_unit: count each presentation with unit in frozen provenance once; sum that presentation's input and target tokens; report first/last clocks and sorted between-presentation step gaps, min/median/max gaps, last-presentation-to-endpoint gap
exposure_spacing_covariates.source_unit_provenance: freeze training-record to exact original-source-unit set before training; declaration records inherit constituent units of their referenced group; source-QA records inherit matching fixed-answer-label units within referenced group, with all ties retained; generic/unrelated records map to empty set
exposure_spacing_covariates.use: descriptive covariates only; no change to fixed exposure/token matching assertions or primary covariate adjustment

influence.cost: cache original prediction/group/block/event sums; CPU-only calculation; benchmark runtime and peak RSS instead of asserting cost
influence.interpretation: point influence only; no retraining, new evaluation, significance selection or causal claim about removing training content
influence.loco: each frozen dependence block, including singleton, removed in turn from equal-block all-source score; same block removed across paired arms wherever assigned to selected role in each replicate; report every case
influence.loeo: each fixed catalog event removed in turn wherever assigned to selected role in each replicate from both original-primary-formula and equal-block all-source score; at most80event cases; report every case
influence.quantities: paired replicate contrast after deletion, deletion-minus-full contrast, mean across complete pairs, maximum absolute mean shift with ties retained; report n_pair and empty-role cases

mapping.acquisition_qa: mean forms within each original acquisition QA target, then mean targets within referenced final source group; separate in-sample diagnostic
mapping.control: explicit raw prepared control source-unit to final approved source-group map, never infer from unit_id alone
mapping.non_unique_or_missing_mapping: fail final binding before training; no guessed provenance
mapping.teaching_qa: expanded form to canonical_probe_id root to original source unit to final approved source group; mean forms per root first
mapping.transfer: exact canonical_probe_id to original source-unit provenance to final approved source group to frozen block to event; variants inherit the same canonical root map

masks.all_preserved_source_exclusion: separate broader diagnostic union all original units carrying preserve_source_ambiguity or preserve_source_conflict in final source disposition receipt
masks.complements: report flagged-only and preserved-only scores, retained/excluded counts by role/event/group/block and all-source scores
masks.empty: empty group/block/event omitted from masked mean and reported as empty, never zero; empty role yields NA
masks.evaluation: recompute both unchanged primary weighting formula and equal-block weighting on each secondary mask; do not change training or primary score
masks.fixed_partition: keep frozen block IDs after filtering; recompute surviving denominators without splitting or reclustering
masks.flagged_alias_conflict_synonym_exclusion: union original source-unit IDs in independently accepted source-only alias/conflict/synonym or fixed-label question-ambiguity findings; D7/D8/D25 and03/07/08 proposed exact IDs supplied in this draft; exclude all predictions attributed to any masked unit, across every role and variant; mask does not itself add a dependence edge
masks.merged_group_qa: exclude acquisition QA record if any unit of its declared source group intersects mask; label this conservative group-provenance exclusion; canonical transfer probes use their exact original unit
masks.unsupported_mask: none inferred; any narrower unsupported-only mask needs separate source-only named-ID adjudication and freeze

paired_replicate_inference.claims: no new significance tests, equivalence decisions, directional claims, multiplicity family or launch gate; original primary inference unchanged
paired_replicate_inference.contrast: for each existing preregistered contrast A-minus-B compute d_r=score_A,r-score_B,r within replicate and report mean d_r
paired_replicate_inference.n_at_least_two: required for interval; n_pair1 gives point only, n_pair0 gives NA
paired_replicate_inference.no_pseudoreplication: no group/probe count used as n; no event bootstrap added by this policy
paired_replicate_inference.secondary_interval: descriptive two-sided95percent Student-t interval mean(d)+/-t_(n_pair-1,.975)*sample_sd(d)/sqrt(n_pair); sample SD uses n_pair-1
paired_replicate_inference.undefined_score: list every valid replicate and its missing secondary score; use complete secondary pairs for descriptive interval and report n_pair explicitly; never remove it from primary sample or change primary missing-pair rules
paired_replicate_inference.unit: independently trained shared-state five-arm replicate, conditional on fixed event pool

partition.block_id: sha256 of canonical JSON containing event ID and sorted final group IDs, prefixed dep-
partition.blocks: connected components of accepted edges within each event; all other groups singleton
partition.d28: ten distinct existing multi-record groups remain ten singleton annotation entries unless separately joined by accepted within-event edges
partition.deduplication: deduplicate identical memberships while retaining all provenance; nested and overlapping sets contribute one connected component
partition.edges: all members of each independently accepted exact within-event dependence set joined; include accepted alias/conflict/synonym edges as dependence, not semantic equivalence
partition.prohibition: no cross-event block, shared-answer heuristic, source merge, gold union, outcome-dependent edge or weight

primary.aggregation: unchanged arithmetic mean of original probe scores within final source group, groups within event, events within role
primary.confirmation_eligibility: unchanged fixed E; valid poorly acquired replicates retained
primary.control_aggregation: unchanged current primary control aggregation over prepared raw units; no silent conversion to grounded primary groups
primary.development_acquisition_gate: unchanged canonical40to70percent inclusive and unchanged common-E selection

prospective_amendments.A1: Explicit primary-secondary sign and descriptive interval zero-coverage divergence for every contrast and endpoint.
prospective_amendments.A2: Average opaque duplicate clusters and acquisition-target forms before source groups. Bind canonical-roots-only transfer proof.
